South Texas Money Management Ltd increased its stake in Alibaba Group Holding Sp (BABA) by 167.22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. South Texas Money Management Ltd bought 62,378 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 99,680 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.19M, up from 37,302 at the end of the previous reported quarter. South Texas Money Management Ltd who had been investing in Alibaba Group Holding Sp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $485.35B market cap company. The stock increased 3.53% or $6.44 $188.89. About 57.79M shares traded or 216.20% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Stillwater Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in International Bus Mach (IBM) by 33.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 7,736 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.19M, down from 11,682 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
